title: Remove remaining outdated homepage headline wording and update HTML metadata

requirements.summary: Remove any remaining user-facing occurrences of the old homepage phrase (including metadata, components, and translations) so the updated wording is shown consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: A codebase-wide check confirms there are no remaining user-facing strings containing "Get Leader-Giotag" (including in HTML metadata, React components, and translation strings).

Where the app previously displayed the old phrase, it now displays the updated wording as specified in REQ-3/REQ-4 (or a deliberate, explicitly preserved alternative if it is not the same UI element).

file_operations.description: Audit and update any translation strings that still include "Get Leader-Giotag" (or close/outdated variants of the homepage headline) so that no language mode can surface the old phrase; keep all updated user-facing text in English as required.
Ensure no remaining user-facing metadata strings contain "Get Leader-Giotag" by aligning document/share titles with the updated wording (also satisfies REQ-4).

Confirm the homepage recent-reports H2 headline is the single source of truth and cannot be overridden by translation/conditional rendering; remove any unused translation hook usage to prevent alternate code paths (also satisfies REQ-3).

requirements.summary: Set the RecentReports homepage section headline to the exact required updated text and prevent any alternate rendering from showing a different headline.
acceptanceCriteria: On the route "/" (home page), the visible H2 headline above the recent reports section matches exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice".
There is no alternate rendering (e.g., conditional language mode, duplicated component, or fallback UI) that shows a different headline on the homepage.

file_operations.description: Hardcode the H2 headline string exactly as specified and ensure there is no translation-driven, conditional, or duplicate headline rendering on the homepage; remove unused imports/state related to language that could introduce alternate text paths.

Verify the home route ("/") renders exactly one RecentReports instance and that no alternate route/component composition can render an older headline variant; keep changes minimal and behavior-preserving.

requirements.summary: Update frontend/index.html document title and social/share titles to remove the old wording and use the updated wording consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <title> no longer contains "Get Leader-Giotag" and uses the updated wording.
frontend/index.html meta property="og:title" no longer contains "Get Leader-Giotag" and uses the updated wording.
frontend/index.html meta name="twitter:title" no longer contains "Get Leader-Giotag" and uses the updated wording.

file_operations.description: Replace "Get Leader-Giotag" in <title>, og:title, and twitter:title with the updated wording aligned to the homepage headline messaging (use English), keeping all other SEO tags unchanged unless necessary for consistency.
